name: Externalization multi-agent row isolation and timeout blocker
purpose: Continue from Item086 by adding targeted arm/source-index controls to the Part-1 runner, verifying those controls with a fast no-LLM mechanics check, and probing one isolated real-LLM team row. The targeted real-LLM row produced no checkpoint before a manual cutoff, so the next blocker is process-level timeout/chunk orchestration before further real-LLM row accumulation.

code_added_used.change: Adds --arms and --source-indices filters and records those filters in the budget ledger so individual long-tail rows can be isolated.

commands.purpose: Verify target filtering writes exactly the requested K/source/arm row.
Probe one isolated real-LLM team row; manually stopped after about 300 seconds without checkpoint output.

headline.single_next_move: Build a process-level one-row executor that records TIMEOUT rows, then resume real-LLM accumulation with bounded wall-clock per row.

gate_outcomes.number: No-LLM check with --arms monolith_KR --source-indices 33 wrote exactly one row: K=2 source_index=33 arm=monolith_KR.
K=2 source_index=33 team row produced no checkpoint/final artifact before manual cutoff around 300s.
Even isolated real-LLM team row can long-tail; full sweep needs process-level timeout/chunk executor.

decision.next_step_routing: Implement a process-level one-row executor/wrapper that marks TIMEOUT rows and preserves checkpoint progress. Then use it to run K=2 rows one at a time before any K=3 or full K6 launch.

rows.reason: Python future/checkpoint controls cannot mark timeout rows if a single row hangs.
Needs timeout row artifact before continuing.
No claim read from row-isolation patch.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish or refute claim 4b. It adds targeting controls and records a real-LLM single-row timeout blocker.
honesty.no_llm_check_scope: The no-LLM filter check is a runner mechanics test, not a baseline or calibration expansion.
honesty.runtime_limit: A real-LLM team row can exceed the interactive cutoff without producing a checkpoint row; process-level timeout is required next.
